title: fix: require three years for the 2-Pollen Senior dev quest
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Changes Senior dev eligibility from 730 to 1,095 days and its reward from 3 to 2 Pollen.
- Preserves existing claimed and pending rewards through the unchanged ledger logic; no migration.
- Updates existing catalog, reward, and threshold tests. All 37 quest tests and Biome pass.
- Two files; 10 lines replaced. No new logic.

gist.headline: Senior pollen, earned slowly
gist.blurb: The Senior dev quest now waits for a properly seasoned GitHub profile: three years in the garden earns 2 Pollen. Existing claimed and pending rewards remain safely tucked in the ledger.
gist.summary: Updated the GitHub-profile Senior dev quest to require 1,095 days of account age instead of 730, with a 2-Pollen reward instead of 3, while preserving existing claimed and pending rewards.
gist.impact: Developers completing the Senior dev quest will now qualify after three years of GitHub history and receive 2 Pollen, with earlier reward records left unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a patient senior gardener wearing tiny reading glasses and a tool belt, checking a large pixel calendar marked “1095 DAYS” beside a mature code-plant with three annual growth rings. A cozy quest-reward jar labeled “2 POLLEN” and a small ledger book represent the updated threshold and preserved reward history.
